sources.label: USDFC conditional FIL redemption and partial fills

reserveReview.rationale: The current issuer overview identifies FIL as Filecoin's native asset and the sole collateral. The exact captured ActivePool source key binds this cryptoasset classification and network identity without changing measured weights or composition date. Redemption releases FIL subject to collateral-ratio and partial-redemption restrictions; no whole-position final USD liquidity maximum is established, so the earlier immediate label is withdrawn.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: FIL-only protocol rules, corroborated by pinned ActivePool and DefaultPool reads at Filecoin block 6422489.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No undisclosed collateral asset in the permitted single-asset book; FIL volatility and pool balances remain variable. FIL has no dedicated reserve-risk mapping; medium is the conservative native-altcoin classification.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Filecoin native collateral is not a tracked stablecoin.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: On-chain pool separation establishes technical custody only; legal segregation, insolvency priority and rehypothecation protections are not established.
